quests.instruction: How many minutes are in 2 hours?
quests.hint: Each hour has 60 minutes. How many hours are there?
quests.explanation: Each hour has 60 minutes, so 2 hours is 60 + 60 = 120 minutes.
quests.funFact: A normal year has 8,760 hours, because 365 days × 24 hours = 8,760.

quests.instruction: Which is longer: 90 minutes or 1 hour 15 minutes?
quests.hint: Change both lengths of time into minutes.
quests.explanation: 1 hour 15 minutes is 60 + 15 = 75 minutes. So 90 minutes is longer than 75 minutes.
quests.funFact: Koalas can sleep for up to 20 hours a day.

quests.instruction: A story lasts 150 minutes. How can this be written in hours and minutes?
quests.hint: Take away 60 minutes for every whole hour you can.
quests.explanation: 150 − 60 − 60 = 30. Two whole hours fit into 150 minutes with 30 minutes left over, so it is 2 hours 30 minutes.
quests.funFact: An animated film is often about 90 minutes long.

quests.instruction: At the start of a rehearsal, the short hand is almost on the 4 and the long hand is on 10. At the end, the long hand is on 5 and the short hand is just past 4. How long is the rehearsal?
quests.hint: Read both clocks as digital times first, then count on.
quests.explanation: The start is 3:50 and the end is 4:25. 3:50 to 4:00 is 10 minutes and 4:00 to 4:25 is 25 more, so 35 minutes.
quests.funFact: The astronomical clock in Prague has been working since 1410.

quests.instruction: A bus journey begins at 7:45 AM and ends at 9:00 AM. How long is the journey?
quests.hint: Count up to 8:00 first, and then on to 9:00.
quests.explanation: 7:45 to 8:00 is 15 minutes, and 8:00 to 9:00 is 1 hour. Altogether the journey lasts 1 hour 15 minutes.
quests.funFact: The first digital wristwatch went on sale in 1972.

quests.instruction: A painting class starts at twenty past ten and ends at five past eleven. How long is the class?
quests.hint: Write both times in digits first.
quests.explanation: Twenty past ten is 10:20 and five past eleven is 11:05. 10:20 to 11:00 is 40 minutes, and 5 more minutes makes 45 minutes.
quests.funFact: Ancient Egyptians used sundials about 3,500 years ago.

quests.instruction: A choir practice starts at 1:50 PM and lasts 1 hour 25 minutes. When does it end?
quests.hint: Add the hour first. Then count on to the next o'clock time and add the rest.
quests.explanation: 1:50 PM plus 1 hour is 2:50 PM. Then 10 minutes reaches 3:00 PM, and 15 more minutes makes 3:15 PM.
quests.funFact: Elephants sleep for only about 3 to 4 hours a day.

quests.instruction: A coach leaves at 9:40 AM and travels for 2 hours 30 minutes. When does it arrive?
quests.hint: Add the 2 hours first, then the 30 minutes. Watch what happens at noon.
quests.explanation: 9:40 AM plus 2 hours is 11:40 AM. Another 30 minutes passes noon, because 20 minutes reaches 12:00 PM and 10 more makes 12:10 PM.
quests.funFact: A bee beats its wings about 200 times every second.

quests.instruction: A concert begins at 11:30 AM and lasts 45 minutes. When does it end?
quests.hint: How many of the 45 minutes are needed to reach noon?
quests.explanation: 11:30 AM to 12:00 PM is 30 minutes. The other 15 minutes make 12:15 PM.
quests.funFact: In a total solar eclipse, the Sun stays completely hidden for at most about 7 minutes.

quests.instruction: A rehearsal ended at 4:10 PM after lasting 1 hour 35 minutes. When did it begin?
quests.hint: Go back 1 hour first, then go back the extra minutes.
quests.explanation: 1 hour before 4:10 PM is 3:10 PM. Going back 35 more minutes: 10 minutes reaches 3:00 and 25 more makes 2:35 PM.
quests.funFact: The first quartz clock was built in 1927.

quests.instruction: A tour ended at 12:20 PM and lasted 50 minutes. When did it begin?
quests.hint: Go back 20 minutes to reach noon, then go back the rest.
quests.explanation: 12:20 PM minus 20 minutes is 12:00 PM, and 30 more minutes back is 11:30. Before noon the time uses AM.
quests.funFact: The world record for the 100 metres sprint is under 10 seconds.

quests.instruction: A sports camp finished at 2:05 PM after 2 hours 15 minutes. When did it begin?
quests.hint: Go back the 2 hours first. Then go back the extra minutes.
quests.explanation: 2 hours before 2:05 PM is 12:05 PM. Going back 15 more minutes gives 11:50 AM.
quests.funFact: One million seconds is about 11 and a half days.

quests.instruction: How many seconds are in 2 minutes?
quests.hint: One minute has 60 seconds.
quests.explanation: Each minute has 60 seconds, so 2 minutes is 60 + 60 = 120 seconds.
quests.funFact: One billion seconds is about 32 years.

quests.instruction: Zoe holds a plank for 90 seconds. How long is that in minutes and seconds?
quests.hint: Take away 60 seconds for one whole minute.
quests.explanation: 60 seconds make 1 minute, and 90 − 60 = 30 seconds left over. So 90 seconds is 1 minute 30 seconds.
quests.funFact: Today a second is defined using atoms, which vibrate more than nine billion times in one second.

quests.instruction: Which is the longest: 100 seconds, 1 minute 30 seconds or 2 minutes?
quests.hint: Change each length of time into seconds.
quests.explanation: The lengths are 100 seconds, 90 seconds and 120 seconds. The longest is 120 seconds, which is 2 minutes.
quests.funFact: A bolt of lightning lasts only a fraction of a second, even though it may seem to flicker.

quests.instruction: The short hand moves from the 4 to the 7. How much time has passed?
quests.hint: The short hand moves forward one number every hour.
quests.explanation: From 4 to 7 is 3 steps, and each step of the hour hand is 1 hour. So 3 hours have passed.
quests.funFact: The hour hand turns 30 degrees every hour, because 360 degrees ÷ 12 = 30.

quests.instruction: The long hand starts on the 4 and moves round to the 11. How many minutes have passed?
quests.hint: Count the steps from 4 to 11. Each step is 5 minutes.
quests.explanation: From 4 to 11 is 7 steps, and 7 × 5 = 35 minutes.
quests.funFact: Early clocks could gain or lose several minutes a day, so people reset them often using a sundial.

quests.instruction: One clock shows 2:15. Later the same clock shows 3:00. How much time has passed?
quests.hint: Count from 2:15 on to the next o'clock time.
quests.explanation: 2:15 to 3:00 is 45 minutes. The long hand goes from the 3 all the way round to the 12.
quests.funFact: Railway station clocks must all agree, or passengers could miss their trains.

quests.instruction: Film A lasts 1 hour 40 minutes and Film B lasts 1 hour 25 minutes. How much shorter is Film B?
quests.hint: Both films are 1 hour plus some minutes. Compare the extra minutes.
quests.explanation: Both films have 1 hour. The extra minutes are 40 and 25, and 40 − 25 = 15. So Film B is 15 minutes shorter.
quests.funFact: The famous university boat race between Oxford and Cambridge takes about 17 to 20 minutes.

quests.instruction: On Monday Jade's journey took 1 hour 10 minutes. On Tuesday it took 50 minutes. How much longer was Monday's journey?
quests.hint: Change 1 hour 10 minutes into minutes first.
quests.explanation: 1 hour 10 minutes is 70 minutes. 70 − 50 = 20 minutes, so Monday's journey was 20 minutes longer.
quests.funFact: The same journey can take a different time each day because of traffic.

quests.instruction: One song lasts 3 minutes 20 seconds and another lasts 2 minutes 50 seconds. What is the difference in length?
quests.hint: Change both songs into seconds first.
quests.explanation: 3 minutes 20 seconds is 200 seconds, and 2 minutes 50 seconds is 170 seconds. 200 − 170 = 30 seconds.
quests.funFact: Most pop songs are between 3 and 4 minutes long.

quests.instruction: A football practice has 35 minutes of drills, a 10-minute rest and a 45-minute match. How long is the practice altogether?
quests.hint: Add the three parts, then change the minutes into hours.
quests.explanation: 35 + 10 + 45 = 90 minutes, which is 1 hour 30 minutes.
quests.funFact: Marathon runners take anywhere from about 2 hours to 6 hours to finish the race.

quests.instruction: Three videos last 12, 18 and 25 minutes. How long do all three take to watch?
quests.hint: Add the minutes in steps, such as 12 + 18 first.
quests.funFact: Adding times in small chunks is how many timetables are built.

quests.instruction: A school day has two lessons of 40 minutes each and a 15-minute break between them. How long is it from the start of the first lesson to the end of the second?
quests.hint: Add both lessons and the break.
quests.explanation: 40 + 15 + 40 = 95 minutes, which is 1 hour 35 minutes.
quests.funFact: Some schools use block lessons of 90 minutes instead of shorter periods.

quests.instruction: An exam lasts 1 hour. 25 minutes have passed. How much time is left?
quests.hint: A whole hour is 60 minutes.
quests.explanation: 60 − 25 = 35 minutes left.
quests.funFact: Clocks and countdown timers in exam rooms help students pace themselves.

quests.instruction: A cycling event lasts 2 hours 30 minutes. A rider has been cycling for 1 hour 45 minutes. How much time is left?
quests.hint: Change both times into minutes.
quests.explanation: 2 hours 30 minutes is 150 minutes and 1 hour 45 minutes is 105 minutes. 150 − 105 = 45 minutes.
quests.funFact: A triathlon combines swimming, cycling and running in one race, and it can last several hours.

quests.instruction: A film is 1 hour 50 minutes long. It started at 7:00 PM. How much of the film is left at 8:20 PM?
quests.hint: First find how long the film has been playing at 8:20.
quests.explanation: From 7:00 to 8:20 is 1 hour 20 minutes. 1 hour 50 minutes − 1 hour 20 minutes = 30 minutes.
quests.funFact: Cinemas often show advertisements for 10 to 20 minutes before the film begins.

quests.instruction: A bus tour lasts 180 minutes. How many hours is that?
quests.hint: Each hour has 60 minutes. How many 60s fit into 180?
quests.explanation: 60 + 60 + 60 = 180, so 180 minutes is 3 hours.
quests.funFact: The Earth is slowing down very slightly, making each day longer by about 2 thousandths of a second every hundred years.

quests.instruction: A lesson ended at 3:10 PM after lasting 1 hour 40 minutes. When did it begin?
quests.hint: Go back 1 hour, then go back 40 more minutes.
quests.explanation: 3:10 PM minus 1 hour is 2:10 PM. Going back 10 minutes reaches 2:00, and 30 more minutes reaches 1:30 PM.
quests.funFact: The seven-day week is thought to have come from ancient Babylon.

quests.instruction: Two films last 1 hour 10 minutes and 55 minutes. A theatre show lasts 2 hours. Which is longer?
quests.correctAnswer: The two films together, by 5 minutes
options: The two films together, by 5 minutes
quests.hint: Add the two films together first.
quests.explanation: 1 hour 10 minutes + 55 minutes = 2 hours 5 minutes, which is 5 minutes more than 2 hours.
quests.funFact: Many computers keep time by counting the seconds since 1 January 1970.
